name: Day's 1st Season ~Ashita no Kimi e~
source:
True love adventure!

Six charming characters - choose one and make a happy ending.
Heartpounding flustered passions of the enamoured!

Will you choose:
Tsundere childhood friend...?
Spontaneous class president...?
Exchange student with poor Japanese...?

All six girls have unique individual personalities.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE069456.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
纯爱冒险！

六名魅力独具的角色——选择一人，迎来幸福结局。
恋爱中的悸动、羞涩与炽热激情！

你会选择：
傲娇青梅竹马……？
率性随心的班长……？
不擅长日语的留学生……？

六名女孩都拥有与众不同的性格。

[根据 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE069456.html]DLsite English[/url]修改]
